mechanism: Cyclosporine is metabolized by CYP3A4, and phenelzine as an MAOI may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism, increasing cyclosporine levels and toxicity risk; concurrent use also increases risk of hypertensive crisis and CNS effects.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, monitor cyclosporine levels closely, watch for signs of toxicity (tremor, hypertension, renal dysfunction), and ensure blood pressure monitoring during concurrent use.
